*Basic effect(s)*
- Randomly changes Ki Spheres of a certain Type to
Rainbow Ki Spheres
- Medium chance of evading enemy's attack

- Chance of performing a critical hit, chance of evading

- DEF 100%{passiveImg:up_g}
*When attacking as the 3rd attacker in a turn*
- ATK 100%{passiveImg:up_g}
- Launches an additional attack that has a high chance of
becoming a Super Attack

- Recovers 30% HP at the end of turn
